title: Weight Class
editorialSummary: Combat sport weight classes sorted by sport (boxing, wrestling, MMA, and judo). False trail: weight class names (flyweight, bantamweight, etc.) are shared across sports, so players may try to group by name rather than sport. The canonical grouping is by the governing body and sport that uses those exact classes.

meta.gptRationale: Weight-class naming systems are sport-specific and easy to confuse across combat sports, especially where labels overlap but structures differ.
